faqs.answer: There is a free parking lot right behind the building, off South Congress. Street parking on the avenue is metered.
faqs.question: Is there parking nearby?

faqs.answer: We take all major cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cash. Payment is after your appointment, at the front desk.
faqs.question: How can I pay?

faqs.answer: Yes, if a stylist is free. Appointments are seen first, so booking ahead is the safer bet, especially on Fridays and Saturdays.
faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?

faqs.answer: You can cancel or move your appointment free of charge up to 24 hours before it starts. Inside 24 hours, or if you do not show up, there is a $25 fee.
faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?

faqs.answer: Please arrive on time. We hold your chair for 10 minutes. After that we may need to shorten the service or rebook you, so the next customer is not kept waiting.
faqs.question: What if I am running late?

faqs.answer: About 2.5 hours, depending on your hair length and how light you want to go. Your stylist will confirm the timing when you book.
faqs.question: How long does balayage take?

faqs.answer: Yes, a 15 minute consultation is free. It is a good idea before a big color change, so the stylist can look at your hair and give you an exact price.
faqs.question: Do you offer a free consultation?

faqs.answer: Tips are not included in our prices. They are always appreciated by the team, and entirely up to you.
faqs.question: Should I tip my stylist?

faqs.answer: We work with sulfate-free, cruelty-free professional lines. If you have an allergy or a product you must avoid, tell us when you book and we will note it on your appointment.
faqs.question: What products do you use?

faqs.answer: Yes, in the salon and over the phone. They can be used for any service and never expire.

knowledge.title: Accessibility
knowledge.text: The salon is step-free from the South Congress entrance and the wash stations are wheelchair accessible. Guide dogs are welcome.

knowledge.title: Bridal and occasion styling
knowledge.text: For weddings and big occasions we suggest a trial session first so the stylist can plan the look. Group bookings for parties of four or more are quoted individually; ask the front desk.
